meta.title: {brand} — the all-in-one platform for Dungeon Masters
meta.description: Prepare your campaign, shape your own mechanics and run tactical combat in one connected place: initiative, damage and effects calculated for you, synced to every player's phone. For D&D-style, turn-based tabletop RPGs.
meta.keywords: dungeon master tools, DM tools, combat tracker, initiative tracker, tabletop RPG, virtual tabletop, campaign manager, custom RPG rules, 5e-style rules, online character sheet

problem.title: How many tabs does your session need?

pains.1: Story notes in one app, character sheets in another
pains.2: Initiative and hit points in a spreadsheet
pains.3: The map and effects somewhere else entirely
pains.4: Music playing from a phone, handouts hiding in a gallery

problem.resolve: One connected environment: prepare once, play without switching.

combat.title: Combat that runs itself
combat.text: The rules engine does the arithmetic while you run the story. Everyone sees the same battle, live, on their own screen.

1.title: Initiative and turns
1.text: A turn queue that advances on its own, with a clear view of whose move it is.

2.title: Attacks, spells and areas
2.text: To-hit, damage and modifiers are calculated automatically, including area spells and zones.

3.title: Conditions, saves and positioning
3.text: Saving throws, conditions, cover, ranged attacks and auras are resolved by the engine.

4.title: Real-time sync
4.text: DM and players see the same battle at once. The player view is built for phones.

5.title: Combat log and DM control
5.text: Every action is logged. Pick the effect of a natural 20 or 1 yourself, or override a result by hand.

6.title: Encounter balancing
6.text: Enemy strength scales to your party automatically, or follow an XP budget for 5e-style encounters.

fx.title: Magic you can see

spells.title: Spells
spells.text: Your own spells with damage, saves, areas and animations.

artifacts.title: Artifacts and sets

rules.title: Rule toggles

how.title: From idea to first battle in four steps

1.title: Create or import content
1.text: Start from scratch or bring your content in from CSV, TSV or JSON.

2.title: Prepare scenario and mechanics
2.text: Write the story, set your rules, bind scenes and battles to the text.

3.title: Invite your players
3.text: Share a campaign code — players join from any browser.

4.title: Run the session
4.text: Launch scenes and battles; everyone sees them at the same moment.

1.q: Do I need other apps to run a game?
1.a: No. The initiative tracker, battle map, hero sheets, scenario, scene show, music and AI assistant all work in one browser window — no dice bots, spreadsheets or separate virtual tabletops.

2.q: Which game systems does it support?
2.a: It is built for D&D-style, turn-based tabletop RPGs, with 5e-style rules and your own custom rules on top. It does not cover every RPG system.

3.q: Can I create my own world?
3.a: Yes. Races, spells, creatures, artifacts, skills and rules are edited without code, separately in each campaign. Start from scratch or import your content.

4.q: Can I import my existing content?
4.a: Yes. Import CSV, TSV or JSON; every row is validated, and you review the result before anything is applied.

5.a: Just a phone or a laptop with a browser. A player enters your campaign code and sees their hero, the battle and the scene slides.

6.q: How does the AI assistant work, and what happens to my key?
6.a: You connect your own Claude, OpenAI or Gemini key. It stays on the server and is never sent to the browser. The assistant only proposes changes; nothing is applied until you review and accept it.
